title: Zoning text change for 200 Kent Avenue, Brooklyn
summary: This zoning text amendment establishes a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area at 200 Kent Avenue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, alongside a related zoning map change. It would support converting and expanding an existing five-story commercial building into a 14-story mixed-use development with 143 dwelling units, of which 29 to 43 would be permanently income-restricted. The Council approved the City Planning Commission's decision with modifications on August 13, 2026.
